axes_source: Read from data/brands/wsj.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #000000 and the canvas #FFFFFF; contrast from the ink #0D0D0D on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #C4262E; density from its 4px spacing base; geometry from its radii 0, 2px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion from its stated durations 150ms; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
brand_rule: The primary #000000 reaches 21.00:1 on the canvas #FFFFFF, at least the 3:1 a control needs, so it carries the action.
